scope: One memory-resident mono IMA4 expanded-index workload. Analytic first-block PCM and timestamps verified on every timed seek. Not GPU,storage,physical-device or whole-player throughput.
ordering_cost: One lazy ordering pass per expanded table. Reordered inputs retain linear lookup; first unordered lookup may pay an extra verification pass. No per-sample heap index is added.
relationship_to_FVID_0444: 0444 removed a discarded lookup in mandatory-preroll seek. This candidate accelerates the necessary lookup for block-independent audio and direct packet seeking; it does not count the earlier removal again.
